raw.rationale: Ro-4987655 is a potent allosteric MEK1/2 inhibitor, and PRISM single-agent screens show MEK inhibitors selectively impair MAPK-pathway-dependent lineages, most notably BRAF/NRAS/RAS-mutant melanoma, colorectal, lung, and thyroid cancers, with little broad cytotoxicity at 2.5 µM. Thus selective lineage effects are expected mainly in skin (melanoma), colorectal, lung, and possibly pancreas/ovary, while most other lineages have low probability.
